lines.zh: 我在沙漠绿洲的浑水里挪动。
lines.en: I move through the muddy water of a desert oasis.

lines.zh: 干河床只剩一道水，我顺着走。
lines.en: The riverbed is dry but for one channel, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我的触须先探路，身体才跟上。
lines.en: My whiskers test the way before my body follows.

lines.zh: 两条鲿鱼一前一后，不并排。
lines.en: Two bayads travel nose to tail, never side by side.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥底，把水搅成褐色。
lines.en: I hug the mud and stir the water brown.

lines.zh: 热带草原的日头晒得水发烫。
lines.en: The savanna sun heats the water until it stings.

lines.zh: 我游过一排枯草，鳍刮着根。
lines.en: I pass a row of dead grass, fins scraping roots.

lines.zh: 水浅得只到我背，我仍往前。
lines.en: The water is only back-deep, and I keep going.

lines.zh: 沙地上有我的印，很快被风抹了。
lines.en: My trail in the sand is erased by wind soon after.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块盐壳，那里太咸。
lines.en: I skirt a salt crust; it is far too salty.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，这片水不值得急。
lines.en: I go slowly; this water is not worth hurrying for.

lines.zh: 一只蜥蜴在岸边看我游过去。
lines.en: A lizard on the bank watches me swim past.

lines.zh: 我一大半身子沉在泥里。
lines.en: More than half of me stays sunk in the mud.

lines.zh: 这里的鱼少，我一动就很显眼。
lines.en: There are few fish here, so my every move shows.

lines.zh: 我用触须扫过泥面，找能吃的东西。
lines.en: I sweep my barbels over the mud, looking for something to eat.

lines.zh: 日头把水晒浅了，我往阴处挪。
lines.en: The sun has burned the water shallow, so I shift into the shade.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边的草根，慢慢往前。
lines.en: I hug the grass roots at the bank and creep forward.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我靠触须认路。
lines.en: When the water muddies, I find my way by feel.

lines.zh: 我伏在泥里，只露出两根触须。
lines.en: I lie in the mud with only two whiskers showing.

lines.zh: 水不流，我也不动。
lines.en: The water is still, and so am I.

lines.zh: 我在这小水塘里等了很久。
lines.en: I have waited a long time in this small pool.

lines.zh: 太阳把水面照成一块铜。
lines.en: The sun turns the water surface to copper.

lines.zh: 我心里数着岸上的脚步声。
lines.en: I count the footsteps on the bank in my head.

lines.zh: 同伴只有一条，就在我下游。
lines.en: There is one companion, just downstream of me.

lines.zh: 泥里有点动静，我侧耳听。
lines.en: Something stirs in the mud; I listen sideways.

lines.zh: 这一带水浅，我没什么可做的。
lines.en: The water here is shallow and there is little to do.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸放慢，省着力气。
lines.en: I slow my breathing to save my strength.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹进水里，我忍了。
lines.en: Wind blows sand into the water, and I endure it.

lines.zh: 我等着水自己变清一点。
lines.en: I wait for the water to clear a little on its own.

lines.zh: 触须碰到石头，我记下位置。
lines.en: A whisker touches stone; I mark the spot.

lines.zh: 我半个头埋在泥里打盹。
lines.en: Half my head is buried in mud as I doze.

lines.zh: 这里没有海，我也活得下去。
lines.en: There is no sea here, and I live anyway.

lines.zh: 我抬起扁头，触须先朝你伸。
lines.en: I raise my flat head, whiskers reaching toward you first.

lines.zh: 你站在干河床边，我浮上来看。
lines.en: You stand at the dry riverbed; I surface to look.

lines.zh: 我看你手里有没有水。
lines.en: I check whether you carry water.

lines.zh: 你的影子遮住了我的小水塘。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my little pool.

lines.zh: 我一只眼朝上，一只眼朝你。
lines.en: One eye looks up, one eye looks at you.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，这里来的人不多。
lines.en: I am not afraid; few people come here.

lines.zh: 你走近，我退到泥洞边上。
lines.en: You come closer; I back to the edge of my mud hole.

lines.zh: 我在沙水里看你，看不太清。
lines.en: I watch you through sandy water, not very clearly.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾满沙，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your boots are covered in sand; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地侧身，把触须收起来。
lines.en: I slowly turn aside and draw my whiskers in.

lines.zh: 你的刀划过，我的触须断了。
lines.en: Your blade passes and severs a whisker.

lines.zh: 我三点血，你一刀就够。
lines.en: I have three health; one cut is enough.

lines.zh: 我往泥里钻，血把水染浑。
lines.en: I burrow into mud; blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 我疼得甩尾，把泥全扬起来。
lines.en: I thrash in pain and throw up all the mud.

lines.zh: 这片水太浅，我没处可逃。
lines.en: This water is too shallow to escape through.

lines.zh: 我硬撑着，把触须收回嘴里。
lines.en: I endure it and draw my whiskers back.

lines.zh: 你打得不重，可我已经不行了。
lines.en: Your hit was light, and I am already failing.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，我还在动。
lines.en: My bones creak, and I still move.

lines.zh: 同伴早沉进泥里，只剩我。
lines.en: My companion sank into the mud; only I am left.

lines.zh: 我记着这一下，鱼也会记。
lines.en: I remember this blow; even fish remember.

lines.zh: 你丢下的虫子，在泥上还在动。
lines.en: The bug you drop is still moving on the mud.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，比这片水更浓的味道。
lines.en: I smell it, stronger than this whole pool.

lines.zh: 触须先抖了一下，我才过去。
lines.en: My whiskers twitch first; then I go.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，泥被搅起来了。
lines.en: I circle it and stir the mud up.

lines.zh: 这点吃的，在旱地里很难得。
lines.en: Food like this is rare in dry country.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又怕是个圈套。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then fear it is a trap.

lines.zh: 那味道让我忘了晒人的太阳。
lines.en: That smell makes me forget the burning sun.

lines.zh: 我一寸一寸地靠近，很有耐心。
lines.en: I close in inch by inch, patiently.

lines.zh: 同伴在后面等，我先去试。
lines.en: My companion waits behind; I test it first.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口，水和虫子都吞了。
lines.en: I suck once and swallow water and bug together.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，泥一下涌起来。
lines.en: You step into the water, and mud surges up.

lines.zh: 我的身子被你撞得歪到一边。
lines.en: Your bump knocks my body off to one side.

lines.zh: 我缩回泥里，只留尾巴在外。
lines.en: I shrink into the mud, leaving only my tail out.

lines.zh: 两根触须撞上你的靴子，软软的。
lines.en: Two whiskers bump your boot, soft and blind.

lines.zh: 我滑了一下，肚皮贴住石头。
lines.en: I slip and my belly flattens against a stone.

lines.zh: 水只有这么点，我们挤在一起。
lines.en: There is so little water that we crowd together.

lines.zh: 你把沙踢进来，我呛了一口。
lines.en: You kick sand in, and I choke on a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我撞开同伴，游到另一边。
lines.en: I bump my companion aside and swim to the other end.

lines.zh: 泥浆糊住我的眼，我停住了。
lines.en: Mud coats my eyes, and I stop moving.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，就各自散了。
lines.en: We touch once, then drift apart.

lines.zh: 我们两条在浅水里并排伏着。
lines.en: The two of us lie side by side in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我用触须碰她的触须。
lines.en: I touch my whiskers to hers.

lines.zh: 这片水太小，只够我们两个。
lines.en: This pool is small, just enough for us two.

lines.zh: 她往泥洞里钻，我跟进去。
lines.en: She slips into the mud hole, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我们不看对方，只挨着。
lines.en: We do not look at each other, only stay close.

lines.zh: 旱地里能碰上同族，不容易。
lines.en: Meeting kin in dry country is not easy.

lines.zh: 我把最好的泥窝让给她。
lines.en: I give her the best mud nest.

lines.zh: 水会干的，所以我们要快。
lines.en: The water will dry up, so we must be quick.

lines.zh: 她动了动鳍，我明白意思。
lines.en: She flicks a fin, and I understand.

lines.zh: 往后这片水会多几条小鱼。
lines.en: Later this water will hold a few more small fish.

lines.zh: 我嘴里没牙，只能含着。
lines.en: I have no front teeth; I can only hold it.

lines.zh: 那块骨粉沉底，我用嘴拱。
lines.en: The bone meal sinks; I root at it with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我咬不住，它从触须间溜了。
lines.en: I cannot grip it; it slips past my whiskers.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到泥坑里藏着。
lines.en: I nudge it into a mud hollow to hide.

lines.zh: 水太浑，我摸了半天。
lines.en: The water is so muddy I grope for a while.

lines.zh: 这味道不像吃的，我松开。
lines.en: It does not smell like food; I let go.

lines.zh: 我吞了一半，又吐出来。
lines.en: I swallow half, then spit it back out.

lines.zh: 有人丢东西进来，我先看看。
lines.en: When something is dropped in, I look first.

lines.zh: 我用肚子压住它，不让它漂。
lines.en: I press it down with my belly so it stays.

lines.zh: 下次涨水，它就不见了。
lines.en: Next flood, it will be gone.

lines.zh: 你搅动的水，我记住了。
lines.en: I mark the water you disturbed.

lines.zh: 这片水塘是我的，你先踩进来的。
lines.en: This pool is mine; you stepped in first.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，朝你的脚去。
lines.en: I lower my head and move toward your feet.

lines.zh: 触须探到你的靴尖，我没退。
lines.en: A whisker finds your boot tip, and I do not retreat.

lines.zh: 鱼少的地方，护起地盘更凶。
lines.en: Where fish are scarce, territory is defended harder.

lines.zh: 我认准了你的脚踝。
lines.en: I fix on your ankle.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我就跟一步。
lines.en: Each time you move, I match one step.

lines.zh: 我不叫，可我已经决定。
lines.en: I make no sound, but I have decided.

lines.zh: 泥里看不见，我靠触须找你。
lines.en: I cannot see in the mud; my whiskers find you.

lines.zh: 你最好别在这水里久留。
lines.en: You had better not linger in this water.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕，泥跟着翻。
lines.en: I circle your feet, mud churning behind me.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，触须就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my whiskers follow.

lines.zh: 我贴着底，等你抬脚。
lines.en: I hug the bottom and wait for you to lift a foot.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我只露出两只眼。
lines.en: You look back; only my two eyes show.

lines.zh: 我不急，旱地的鱼都能等。
lines.en: I am patient; fish of dry lands can wait.

lines.zh: 水太浅，我绕不了大圈。
lines.en: The water is too shallow for wide circles.

lines.zh: 你的倒影一乱，我就动。
lines.en: When your reflection breaks, I move.

lines.zh: 我在找你的脚跟，那里最软。
lines.en: I look for your heel, the softest spot.

lines.zh: 你踩得越重，水声越帮我。
lines.en: The heavier you step, the more the water tells me.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔着半格水。
lines.en: Only half a block of water lies between us.

lines.zh: 我用头顶你的脚背，一下一下。
lines.en: I butt the top of your foot, again and again.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的鞋带，往泥里拽。
lines.en: I clamp onto your shoelace and haul it into the mud.

lines.zh: 我的触须抽在你脚踝上。
lines.en: My whiskers whip across your ankle.

lines.zh: 这一撞没那么疼，但我还会来。
lines.en: This shove hardly hurts, but I will come again.

lines.zh: 我整条鱼压上你的靴子。
lines.en: I press my whole body onto your boot.

lines.zh: 你踢开我，我又滑回来。
lines.en: You kick me away, and I slide right back.

lines.zh: 泥水溅了你一腿。
lines.en: Muddy water splashes up your leg.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，只咬到皮革。
lines.en: I bite once and get only leather.

lines.zh: 在旱地里，我不轻易放手。
lines.en: In dry country, I do not let go easily.

lines.zh: 你退出去，我才停下。
lines.en: Only when you step out do I stop.

lines.zh: 一场雨过后，我在水洼里出现。
lines.en: After a rain, I appear in a puddle.

lines.zh: 这水塘小得可怜，可我出生在这。
lines.en: This pool is pitifully small, but I was born here.

lines.zh: 睁眼时，身边只有一条同伴。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, only one companion is near.

lines.zh: 我只有三点血，得省着用。
lines.en: I have only three health and must spend it carefully.

lines.zh: 沙地冒着热气，我先沉进泥里。
lines.en: The sand steams; I sink into the mud first.

lines.zh: 绿洲的水养得起我，暂时。
lines.en: The oasis water can raise me, for now.

lines.zh: 我从泥洞里钻出来，浑身是沙。
lines.en: I crawl from a mud hole covered in sand.

lines.zh: 这片旱地很少生出我这样的鱼。
lines.en: This dry land rarely births a fish like me.

lines.zh: 我一出生就知道水会干。
lines.en: I know from birth that the water will dry.

lines.zh: 我只有这么一小片水可活。
lines.en: I have only this one small patch of water.

lines.zh: 火把燎过水面，我的鳍卷了。
lines.en: A torch sweeps the surface and curls my fins.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，摔在热沙里。
lines.en: I am flung ashore and land on hot sand.

lines.zh: 我在泥水里，反而喘不上气。
lines.en: In muddy water, I am the one who cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水洼掀干，我摔在泥上。
lines.en: The blast empties the pool and throws me onto mud.

lines.zh: 箭从水面穿下来，扎进我的背。
lines.en: An arrow comes down through the water into my back.

lines.zh: 紫光扫过，我的触须全僵了。
lines.en: Violet light sweeps past and every whisker stiffens.

lines.zh: 水洼里的虫子早没了，我饿穿了。
lines.en: The pool's bugs are long gone, and I am hollow.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙地上，水一下带电了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and the water becomes charged.

lines.zh: 水塘漏空了，我掉进黑里。
lines.en: The pool drains away, and I drop into black.
